name: Tofu Pad Thai with Rice Noodles and Peanuts

components.name: Tofu Pad Thai
steps: Soak dry rice noodles in warm water until flexible but not soft; drain thoroughly.
Whisk vegetarian tamarind concentrate, soy sauce, sugar and lime into an even sauce.
Drain and cube tofu, then fry in half the oil over medium-high heat until browned and firm. Remove to a plate.
Add remaining oil, cook carrot and scallions briefly, push aside and scramble the beaten egg until fully set.
Add softened noodles, sauce and tofu, tossing over high heat until noodles soften and absorb sauce; fold in sprouts last.
Portion into four containers and pack crushed peanuts and coriander separately; this recipe uses soy sauce in place of nonvegetarian fish sauce.

notes: Draft — needs Mirna review: not kitchen-tested yet; macros and cooked yields are estimates.
New vegetarian adaptation; published Pad Thai sometimes includes shrimp and fish sauce, neither is used here. Source handling: Source technique/reference; measured UNHANGRY complete-meal adaptation.
Planning: Wok cooking plus pre-soaking noodles.
Freezer: noodles can soften after freezing; toppings fresh; better chilled for 2-3 days
Dietary: Soy, peanut and egg; check tamarind sauce has no fish.
Keeps 3–4 days in the fridge (≤4°C); refrigerate within 2 hours (1 hour above 32°C) in shallow containers, freeze portions for later in the week, and reheat to at least 74°C.
